description: Find and preview public legal templates. Start or resume a Nevada LLC questionnaire on Neon Law’s website.

interface.longDescription: Find and preview public legal templates. Start or resume a Nevada LLC questionnaire on Neon Law’s website.
defaultPrompt: Help me form a Nevada LLC.

positive.prompt: My Nevada LLC is member-managed and I am its only member. I own it personally. Help me start an operating agreement.
